text:
Type: drop-leaf dining table with drawer
Use: dining, flexible eating space; small kitchen, dining room, studio apartment
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: black-brown stained solid wood and veneer, metal knob
Colors: black-brown, dark espresso
Shape: compact rectangular center top with two hinged leaves that fold down, small front drawer, turned legs with low stretchers, narrow when folded
Feel: cozy, practical, timeless, warm
Goes with: white walls, black or wood chairs, cream textiles; small classic kitchens and farmhouse dining corners

product.name: INGATORP
product.description: Table with drop-leaves seats 2-4; makes it possible to adjust the table size according to need.
